metadata.title: The Crown of Echoes
metadata.description: A fallen king's spirit awakens within a mortal vessel to reclaim a shattered kingdom, only to discover the crown holds a darker power than expected.
metadata.author: PiperScenarioLab

act_1.name: The Awakening
act_1.description: The hero awakens in the obsidian throne room and discovers the first signs of the shadow's presence.

scene_1_1.name: Obsidian Awakening
scene_1_1.description: You wake up in a cold throne room, feeling the ancient magic pulse within your chest.

scene_1_2.name: Distant Screams
scene_1_2.description: Hearing screams, you find a wounded guard and a map of the fractured realms.

obj_1_1.description: Secure the map of the fractured realms.

act_2.name: The Shadow's Grip
act_2.description: You travel through fractured realms to gather allies and items to counter the shadow's influence.

scene_2_1.name: The Forest of Whispers
scene_2_1.description: You meet a mystic who reveals the shadow's weakness requires the crown's power.

scene_2_2.name: The Ruined Spire
scene_2_2.description: A battle ensues where you recover a key artifact using the map from the previous act.

obj_2_1.description: Defeat the shadow lieutenant in the spire.

act_3.name: The Final Ascension
act_3.description: Return to the throne room to unite the realms and master the crown's ancient magic.

scene_3_1.name: Reunion of Realms
scene_3_1.description: You bring the allies together, synchronizing the fractured magic with the crown.

scene_3_2.name: The Shadow Confrontation
scene_3_2.description: The usurper is consumed by the crown's light, restoring balance to the realm.

obj_3_1.description: Master the crown's magic and defeat the shadow usurper.

act_3.ending_narration: The realm is restored to balance, the shadow usurper consumed by the crown's light, and you ascend as the new guardian of the eternal cycle.

npc_01.name: Lady Elara

persona.voice: Soft but trembling, laced with melancholy
motives: Find the source of the shadow
fears: The shadow consuming the last of the light
persona.speech_style: Metaphorical, poetic, often pauses to compose words

knows: The crown pulses only when pure intent is held
Lady Elara's father knew the usurper's weakness
can_reveal: The location of the First Sanctum
How to calm the crown's rage

npc_02.name: General Varkas

persona.voice: Raspy and commanding, rarely breaks stride
motives: Prove his worth against the usurper
fears: Being labeled traitor by the usurper's allies
persona.speech_style: Direct, clipped sentences, uses military jargon

knows: The shadow moves faster in the rain
A secret passage beneath the throne
can_reveal: Tactics to bypass the usurper's guards
The true location of the fractured realms

npc_03.name: Oracle Morn

persona.voice: Echoing and multi-layered, sounding like many voices
motives: Ensure the crown is not misused
fears: The crown's power corrupting the bearer
persona.speech_style: Cryptic, riddles, speaks in past and future tenses interchangeably

knows: The usurper is a reflection of the hero's doubt
The crown requires sacrifice to fully awaken
can_reveal: The name of the usurper's true form

npc_04.name: Rook

persona.voice: Hoarse and quick, with a constant grin
fears: The dark beasts of the ruins
persona.speech_style: Colloquial, slang-heavy, uses humor to deflect danger

knows: Where the shadow hides its weapons
How to trade with the ruins' inhabitants
can_reveal: A side quest involving a lost artifact
The location of the Scavenger's Guild

item_01.name: Crown Shard
item_01.description: A jagged piece of the Crown of Echoes that hums with residual power. It warms the hand when held near the usurper.

item_02.name: Shadow-Steel Dagger
item_02.description: A blade forged from metal stolen from the usurper's armor. It glows faintly red when near shadow energy.

item_03.name: Elixir of Clarity
item_03.description: A vial of glowing blue liquid. Drinking it temporarily removes confusion and strengthens the connection to the crown's magic.

item_04.name: Rust-Resistant Rations
item_04.description: Hardtack and dried meat wrapped in oilskin. Essential for surviving long treks through the decaying realms.

skill_01.name: Echo Sense
skill_01.description: Allows the player to detect hidden enemies or magical disturbances by listening to the 'echoes' left in the air.

skill_02.name: Crown Resonance
skill_02.description: Temporarily boosts the player's magical abilities, allowing them to manipulate the crown's energy more effectively.

skill_03.name: Shadow Step
skill_03.description: Enables the player to briefly phase through shadows, bypassing obstacles or escaping danger zones.
